reviews.text:
I've known Felipe's work for almost 3 years and I can say... Trust him completely!
I needed to leave my two pets, Romeo and Pretinha, at the CT (Training Center) because of my pregnancy, and despite my apprehension about leaving them away for so many months, Felipe had a very professional chat with me, explaining the importance of boarding and the importance of the work that would be done in this case. When I sent them to the CT, I could see how well cared for and loved they were every day! They were like real dogs, haha! They ran, played, did daily activities, had themed parties, and more. Whenever necessary, they had an evaluation with a veterinarian if needed. Medication and food were always given on time and in the proper way. I received videos and photos of my babies daily! And on visiting days, I was surprised to see how happy and well-integrated they were with other pets and how well cared for they were, because my Romeo suffers from dermatitis that caused a lot of inflammation on his skin, and I always reinforced with Felipe the care he needed. And they even helped me a lot with that!! They observed what was causing the injuries while driving and treated them accordingly. Today my Romeo has returned from the training center after 10 months and is doing great. Even at home they follow the training center routine, even at bedtime! Haha. I can only thank Felipe and the Patas ao Vento training center for all the care and love dedicated to my pets during this period. The girls are incredible and took care of them with so much love. I recommend them without hesitation and whenever they need to, I know it's a safe place to board them. Congratulations on the incredible work you do.
Felipe has been taking care of my two bulldogs for years, and they're always so happy to spend a few days with him! I highly recommend him!

I'm biased, because Hanna is 5 and a half years old and Felipe started training her when she was 2 months old, and he did that job for 2 years!
And whenever I travel, he's the one who stays with Hanna.
Not to mention that she's completely in love with Felipe! I'm so grateful for taking such good care of my four-legged daughter! 🫶

For the past 4 years, my pets have been cared for, trained, and treated by Felipe and Dilma. I travel several times a year and trust them alone to host Cristal and Safira.

Besides the recreation and boarding space, my greatest confidence comes from Felipe being a trainer who truly knows how to handle animals. He understands their behavior and corrects them when necessary.

For the past year, he has also been training my mother's dog, who we thought was beyond help. And today, he is clearly a happy and well-cared-for dog.

I give Felipe, Dilma, and the space they have built a score higher than 5.

Thank you so much for always taking care of our pets with so much love and affection.

Excellent experience, 1000 out of 10!
Felipe is an excellent professional and provides assistance with everything that is needed.

Terrible! My friend and I share custody of a dog, and she decided to take him to Felipe for training. We were allowed to see him about 7-10 days after he started intensive training (where the dog stays at Felipe's "training center"). I went once, and right away I saw that my dog ​​was very scared and timid. As we were leaving, he locked the dog in the crate (the transport crate, where he ate and had to learn to be confined without crying or barking: prevented from having any kind of reaction). As we were leaving, Felipe asked us to wait to see how he would react being locked up and seeing us leave. We followed his advice, the dog cried and started barking, Felipe KICKED the crate with the dog STUCK inside and YELLED (totally different behavior from before we left), and most importantly, in front of us. At that moment, I realized what kind of training it was. From that day on, only my friend (who paid for the training) was allowed to visit. I didn't go back to see him; 30-odd days passed. Felipe wanted him to stay another 30 days because the dog was having different reactions WHILE LOCKED IN THE CRATE. He wasn't crying like he did at the beginning, but according to him, he was "digging" in the crate. He also suggested buying a "shock" collar to prevent barking while he was confined. We decided to take him out. The result: a fractured fourth molar from trying to break the cage bars (which, according to Felipe, was the ideal confinement time of up to 3 hours), a dog 3 kg lighter, and covered in bedsores.

For those who have doubts, see the photos in the review. And if you still have doubts even with the photos, I have veterinary reports and diagnoses from those who have always monitored my dog, regarding his condition before and after this so-called intensive separation anxiety training.

Without further ado, my dog ​​is withdrawn, with a fractured tooth that required surgery two days after arriving home. I'm taking my dog ​​home because the root of his molar was exposed and full of sores. If anyone has any questions about the case, feel free to contact me!

I'm making this assessment because NO ANIMAL SHOULD GO THROUGH THIS, and they can't defend themselves. I don't wish what I went through with my dog ​​after going to that training, and I MUCH LESS wish what my dog ​​went through for your pet!

Felipe Dog trainee
I couldn't walk Thor on the street, he was very restless and even a little violent.

Thor stayed with Felipe for 30 days, and he always sent videos of him walking Thor on the street with dedication and skill.
Thank you very much, Felipe, for the progress with Thor.
I've already been walking him calmly on the street for 2 days, and he's a completely different Thor.
Thank you, Felipe 👏👏👏👏

Hey Felipe, I want to thank you for all the training and, especially, for the care and affection you showed Paçoca. He's a completely different dog now. Extremely well-behaved, he only pees on the training pad, and most importantly: he doesn't bark anymore when I leave. I will definitely always recommend you. Congratulations on your work and for being such an excellent professional. Big hug!

Leaving my dog ​​with Felipe for a month was a big challenge for me and my family, but today I can say with certainty that it was the best decision we made. From the beginning, he instilled complete confidence in me and cared for her as if she were his own, always sending us videos of the training activities.
The result was incredible: my dog ​​returned more confident, balanced, and very happy. Felipe's care, dedication, and professionalism are simply exceptional.
I am immensely grateful for all the work done. I recommend him without hesitation! Without a doubt, Felipe's house has become her second home. I highly recommend him!

Felipe has been an angel in our lives! He has been helping us a lot with our girls who, after more than 3 years of living together, started fighting! With a lot of security, limits, rules, patience and a lot of respect for the nature of dogs, he has been accompanying and guiding us in their adaptation! After intensive training, we are returning to our routine with very positive results!
Thank you, Felipe! 🙏❤️

I hired Felipe to help me with my two dogs, and in just two lessons, he completely transformed our routine. We were facing problems with aggression and difficulties on walks—lots of pulling, pushing, and stress. Felipe not only corrected …
